Finish with recommendations and follow-up prompts.

Recommendations: rank them, most valuable first. For each, say what it costs, what it buys,
and what would have to be true for it to be wrong. Give a recommendation rather than an
exhaustive survey of options — if you are weighing a choice, pick one and say why.

Follow-up prompts: write them as prompts I can paste back verbatim to start the next piece
of work. Each should stand on its own, naming the file, the task id or the query it starts
from, so it does not depend on this conversation's context surviving.

Separate what you would do next from what you need me to decide. Anything blocked on my
